d: Three BBQ powerhouse chefs showcase their personalities on a plate in the Wildfire Round. It’s a battle between apples and oranges in the Crossfire Round, and fowl play is called in the Feast of Fire.
The three chefs are all eyes and ears when the Crossfire Round ingredients are revealed, and the judges indulge in a Feast of Fire handpicked from the Butcher Shop.

st: Do You Have What It Bakes?
d: Ten home bakers dive into the wonderful world of chocolate and must tackle the art of table tempering.   In the Elimination Challenge, creativity runs wild as the home bakers create a chocolate dessert based on an animal

st: Where There’s A Whisk, There’s A Way
d: The nine home bakers use chocolate to create playful and delicious vessels to hold their desserts in their Technique Test. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers are surprised with two mystery ingredients.

st: It’s Time To Glaze The Bar
d: The eight home bakers take a journey to the world of galaxy mirror glaze as they create a solar system cake for their technique test. The home bakers flex their taste buds as they identify ingredients in a taste-off.
Sweet safety is on the line for the seven remaining home bakers. In the Technique Test, the bakers learn how to incorporate a rainbow of colour into their desserts and create edible works of art.

The top six home bakers get their sweet on and create a dynamic chocolate sculpture for their Technique Test. Then the bakers get some sweet inspiration from home to spark the creation of a dozen delicious donuts.

st: Bake It Till You Make It
d: The five remaining home bakers must create a beautiful collection of bonbons for their Technique Test but the judges have a BIG twist up their sleeves... In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers get experimental.

The final four bakers must create theatrical desserts where chocolate takes centre stage. With the finale one challenge away, the pressure is on as the home bakers use a piece of art to inspire their creations.

st: You Bake My Dreams Come True
d: In this epic season finale, the home bakers take on the most demanding bake of the entire competition – creating a sweet, delicious, show-stopping bakeshop display. One home baker will walk away with the $50,000.
In their first Skills Test, the Junior Chefs must serve-up a signature egg dish. The Junior Chef who surpasses the judges’ eggspectations wins an advantage.

Nine Junior Chefs enter the kitchen for a sauce battle Skills Test, stirring up one of three classic sauces. After just 15 minutes, the best junior sauciers as determined by the judges will each earn an advantage.
The eight remaining Junior Chefs team up to create the ultimate after school snack platter using fruits, vegetables and proteins.
This week Chef Jordan Andino gives a demo in flavour building by creating a classic Caesar Salad with a balance of salty, crunchy, savoury and umami components.
Six Junior Chefs remain and are tasked with making a batch of cookies for Anna Olson! When it comes to cookies the sky is the limit, but the clock has only 20 minutes.
The top five Junior Chefs get an assist from a familiar face: their moms and dads! Working in pairs they must recreate a gorgeous stack of Belgian Waffles in this Skills Test relay race.

Just four Junior Chefs remain in the competition’s semi-final round. Season one champion Audrey returns with words of wisdom, inspiration and a demonstration for the young chefs on the verge of victory.

For their last challenge of the season, the top three Junior Chef finalists must create a concept, name and menu for their very own pop-up restaurant. In three intense rounds of cooking they will their hearts out.
Three chefs are fired up in the Wildfire Round.  In the Crossfire Round, two chefs battle for the best lamb belly, and in the Feast of Fire the judges enjoy a dinner at the Diner.

Three chefs enter the Fire Masters Arena ready to show off their flame game.  In the Crossfire Round, it’s the battle of the taco and in the Feast of Fire, the chefs romance the judges with their date night themed feasts.
